places.name: Davy Crockett National Forest
places.coord_point: Ratcliff Lake Recreation Area (best-known campground; the district office coordinates are not printed on any page checked)
places.blurb: East Texas national forest centred on Ratcliff Lake Recreation Area, with single sites, group shelters, primitive camping and horse camps.
places.status_note: Ratcliff Lake page: no featured alerts, site open (when fetched). Fire danger 'Extreme' is forest-wide, not site-specific. A Forest Service release dated April 11, 2026 says Black Creek Lake Recreation Area is temporarily closed for road improvements; the release does not say which forest, so verify before publishing.
places.notes: COORDS: the point is Ratcliff Lake Recreation Area, printed on the official Ratcliff Lake page as 31.3835 and -95.1533 (verified in raw HTML that the page carries no other point). The official office page prints no coordinates. COUNTY: Houston, per the Wikipedia Ratcliff article (which also places Ratcliff 3.5 miles east of Kennard) and the Wikipedia forest infobox. The forest article also says it lies in Trinity County too. ACRES: 160,647 acres, Wikipedia infobox (the forest's own page gives no total). OFFICE: physical address FS Road 574, Kennard TX 75847; mailing 18551 State Highway 7 East, Kennard; phone (936) 655-2299; open Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. (official office page). A search snippet's fact sheet placed the district office in Ratcliff; not resolved, and the official office page is trusted. CAMPING, RATCLIFF LAKE (official page): single sites with or without a 30-amp electric hookup (rv_hookups only for the hookup sites; the page does not say tent), group campsites (non-electric), group shelters (reservation-only, book at least two days ahead), no horses allowed at this site. Fees: day use $5 per vehicle; single site $15 without hookup or $20 with 30-amp hookup; group site $30 per day up to 20 people. The page lists the no-hookup rate both per night and per day, so the period is inconsistent. Quiet time 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. CAMPING, OTHER SITES (second-hand search snippets, not checked on fs.usda.gov pages): Neches Bluff Overlook primitive camping; 514-D White Rock Horse Camp (vault toilet only); 566 Piney Creek Horse Camp ($10 per day, horse trail about 53 miles). Equestrian and primitive are included on this basis. Reservation URL is Ratcliff's, from its official page. Older alert: Four C National Recreation Trail listed as affected, about 15 months old per a snippet, current status unknown.
